hero.heading: Our Industry Partners
hero.subheading: Culinary Academy collaborates with leading 5-star hotel chains, global culinary bodies, and elite restaurant networks to ensure premium placement and training standards.

partners.name: Radisson Blu, Dhaka & Chattogram
partners.description: Culinary Academy students receive preferential placement for their mandatory 3-month industrial training at Radisson Blu hotels. Executive Chefs from Radisson also conduct specialized masterclasses at our Dhanmondi campus.
benefits: Direct recruitment pathway for top Culinary Academy graduates
Quarterly curriculum review by Radisson Executive Chefs

partners.name: The Westin, Dhaka
partners.description: Through our institutional partnership, The Westin Dhaka hosts advanced kitchen demonstrations for Culinary Academy diploma students. This collaboration focuses heavily on global cold-kitchen and pastry standards.
benefits: Access to advanced commercial kitchen operation models
Priority invitation for banquet and event training sessions
Joint vocational training certificates for select modules

partners.name: InterContinental Dhaka
partners.description: InterContinental Dhaka works with Culinary Academy to align our curriculum with high-authority global hygiene and food science guidelines, ensuring Culinary Academy students enter international kitchens fully pre-equipped with elite compliance training.
benefits: Guest lectures by certified food safety officers
Preferential hiring during seasonal peak operations
